initiative.title: Diagram structure: soft groups, swim lanes and sequence
initiative.summary: Let groups say 'belongs together' without driving layout (frame=soft), add a lanes layout over root groups, and hold sequence diagrams for a later yes.
initiative.next_action: Byron answers the product questions; then M1 (soft groups) after the #125 fix lands.

sources.location: Byron voice memo, 2026-10-26, relayed by orchestrator session
sources.anchor: containers drive layout; fewer containers; Mermaid types worth recovering: swim lanes, sequence
layered layout places a multi-rank group as one block
draftably vary to generate, rank and apply layout variants

sources.location: Mermaid, PlantUML and BPMN 2.0 public docs (agent knowledge, not re-fetched)

claims.statement: Containers currently drive layout and make diagrams bigger than their content needs.
Byron wants to say nodes belong together without forcing a frame, so layout keeps freedom to move them.
Removing frames entirely loses meaning (labels, color, clustering); the relation must still read.
Recover a few Mermaid diagram types, probably swim lanes and sequence, as more opinionated grid forms.
vary could offer a fewer-containers variant.

shape.appetite: Four to five PRs for soft groups and lanes; sequence is a separate decision.
shape.problem: A group is the only way to relate nodes, and it pads, adds a header and ranks as one block.
shape.recommended_shape: frame=box|soft|none on group; soft members use their nearest framed ancestor as layout parent and draw on a tint; then layout root lanes over root groups with global ranks.
success_moves: Use a layout-parent map so soft groups need no engine change.
Keep frame=box the default so every existing file is byte-identical.
Prove with the #125 repro and the 16 grouped examples before adding cohesion.
Build lanes on the same global-rank rule instead of a new engine.
Hold sequence until lanes prove the 'opinionated form as a layout recipe' approach.

first_proof.question: Does a soft group shrink drawings without its tint covering non-members?
first_proof.artifact: Area and soft-overlap table for the #125 repro and 16 grouped examples, with every group frame=soft.
first_proof.decision_rule: Most files shrink and few overlap: ship the bounding-box tint. Overlaps common: do M2 cohesion and union hull before the tint ships.

rabbit_holes: Hull shapes (concave, rounded unions) beyond a union of padded boxes.
Viewer drag and collapse for soft groups.
open_decisions: Tint look: tint plus label, dotted outline, or nothing.
Whether the agent skill should prefer soft groups for new files.

milestones.title: Soft groups draw a tint and stop driving layout
milestones.done_when: #125 repro with frame=soft matches no-group ranks; frame=box files byte-identical; proof table in PR.
milestones.outcome: Soft groups stop ranking as one block and draw as a tint.
milestones.proof: #125 repro ranks match the no-group file; area/overlap table over 16 examples.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: frame=box files draw byte-identical; soft is opt-in.
milestones.rollback: Revert the PR; no file uses frame= yet.

milestones.title: Soft members stay together
milestones.done_when: No soft-overlap on bundled examples with all groups soft.
milestones.outcome: Soft members stay contiguous and the tint covers only members.
milestones.proof: soft-overlap count is zero on bundled examples with all groups soft.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: M1 behavior plus cohesion; box files unchanged.
milestones.rollback: Revert; M1 tint still works with overlap notes.

milestones.title: Swim lanes
milestones.done_when: Example lanes file places every node at its global rank in its own band.
milestones.outcome: A process with roles draws as swim lanes at global ranks.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: New recipe only; other layouts unchanged.
milestones.rollback: Revert; files without lanes are unaffected.

milestones.title: Fewer containers in vary
milestones.done_when: vary lists a softened variant for kubernetes-cluster with smaller area and no overlap.
milestones.proof: vary on kubernetes-cluster lists a smaller softened variant.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: vary works with or without the variant.
milestones.rollback: Drop the variant from the list.

milestones.title: Sequence diagrams, messages only
milestones.done_when: Six-message login sequence draws in file order with lifelines; +edge shows in place.
milestones.outcome: Interactions draw as sequence diagrams with messages in file order.
milestones.proof: Six-message login sequence screenshot; +edge shows in place.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: New recipe only; other layouts unchanged.
milestones.rollback: Revert; files without sequence are unaffected.
milestones.note: Needs Byron yes before work starts.
